description: Vehicle recalls (batch / fleet) — Check NHTSA safety recalls for up to 10 vehicles in one call. vehicles = make,model,year entries separated by ; (e.g. honda,civic,2019;toyota,camry,2020). Returns recall counts, do-not-drive / park-outside recalls, top components and the latest campaigns per vehicle, a ranking, and a fleet verdict (ACTION NEEDED / CHECK REMEDIES / NO RECALLS FOUND). Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: vehicle_recalls_batch
